mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMappingCount */ COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mapping m1 WHERE 1=1

SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMappingList */ m1.rdf_mappg_id , m1.rdf_form_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS rdf_form_mtcd_nm , m1.type_model_id , t1.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t1.model_logic_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd , c2.mtcd_nm AS rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_regr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_reg_dt , m1.rdf_mappg_amdr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_amdr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mapping m1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON m1.rdf_form_mtcd = c1.mtcd and c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00009' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t1 ON m1.type_model_id = t1.model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c2 ON m1.rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd = c2.mtcd and c2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY m1.rdf_form_mtcd, t1.model_sort_odrg

SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMapping */ m1.rdf_mappg_id , m1.rdf_form_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS rdf_form_mtcd_nm , m1.type_model_id , t1.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t1.model_logic_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd , c2.mtcd_nm AS rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_regr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_reg_dt , m1.rdf_mappg_amdr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_amdr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mapping m1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON m1.rdf_form_mtcd = c1.mtcd and c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00009' LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t1 ON m1.type_model_id = t1.model_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c2 ON m1.rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd = c2.mtcd and c2.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00002' WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mapping WHERE rdf_form_mtcd = #{rdfFormMtcd} AND type_model_id = #{typeModelId} AND rdf_mappg_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use')

SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMappingModelList */ m1.rdf_mappg_model_id , m1.rdf_mappg_id , m1.rdf_class_id , c1.rdf_class_nm , c1.rdf_class_logic_nm , n1.rdf_nmsp_pfix , CONCAT(n1.rdf_nmsp_pfix, ':', c1.rdf_class_nm) AS rdf_class , CONCAT(n1.rdf_nmsp_uri, c1.rdf_class_nm) AS rdf_class_iri , m1.rdf_rep_model_yn , m1.rdf_cond_odrg , m1.cond_model_id , t1.model_nm AS cond_model_nm , m1.rdf_mappg_model_regr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_model_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_model_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_model_reg_dt , m1.rdf_mappg_model_amdr_id , m1.rdf_mappg_model_amdr_nm , TO_CHAR(m1.rdf_mappg_model_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_model_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel m1 LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_rdf_class c1 ON m1.rdf_class_id = c1.rdf_class_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_rdf_namespace n1 ON c1.rdf_nmsp_id = n1.rdf_nmsp_id LEFT JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t1 ON m1.cond_model_id = t1.model_id WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId} ORDER BY rdf_cond_odrg ASC
SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMappingModelMaxOdrg */ MAX(rdf_cond_odrg) FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId}
mapper.update: UPDATE /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.updateRdfMapping */ dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel SET rdf_cond_odrg = #{rdfCondOdrg} WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId} AND rdf_rep_model_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT /* SQL_ID: RdfMappingMapper.selectRdfMappingModel */ t1.rdf_mappg_model_id , t1.rdf_mappg_id , t1.rdf_class_id , t2.rdf_class_nm , CONCAT(t3.rdf_nmsp_pfix, ':', t2.rdf_class_nm) AS rdf_class , CONCAT(t3.rdf_nmsp_uri, t2.rdf_class_nm) AS rdf_class_iri , t1.rdf_rep_model_yn , t1.rdf_cond_odrg , t1.cond_model_id , t1.rdf_mappg_model_regr_id , t1.rdf_mappg_model_regr_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.rdf_mappg_model_reg_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_model_reg_dt , t1.rdf_mappg_model_amdr_id , t1.rdf_mappg_model_amdr_nm , TO_CHAR(t1.rdf_mappg_model_amd_dt, #{sqlDateFormat}) AS rdf_mappg_model_amd_dt FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_rdf_class t2 ON t1.rdf_class_id = t2.rdf_class_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_rdf_namespace t3 ON t2.rdf_nmsp_id = t3.rdf_nmsp_id WHERE t1.rdf_mappg_model_id = #{rdfMappgModelId}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId} AND cond_model_id = #{condModelId})
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_rdf_mappingmodel WHERE rdf_mappg_id = #{rdfMappgId} AND cond_model_id = #{condModelId} AND rdf_mappg_model_id != #{rdfMappgModelId})
